title.zh: 空间对角线 · 3D 里的两次勾股
title.en: The Space Diagonal · Pythagoras Twice, in 3D

desc.zh: 长方体里最长的那条斜线有多长？把立体压回平面算两次：先在底面用勾股算出对角线，再拿它当一条直角边、竖起高来第二次勾股。拖动 3D 长方体转着看，两次勾股都写在真实的棱上。
desc.en: How long is the longest line inside a box? Flatten the solid back into planes and apply Pythagoras twice: first across the base, then using that diagonal as one leg of a vertical right triangle. Orbit the 3D cuboid and watch both applications drawn on the real edges.
